caption: The drawing depicts a single dark-colored metal mug with a handle, centered on a plain, lightly textured beige background. The mug is cylindrical with a slightly rounded bottom and a sturdy handle attached to its side. The surface of the mug exhibits various shades of brown and black with reflective highlights, suggesting a metallic material. The rim of the mug has a small chip or indentation. Below the mug, towards the bottom right of the drawing, the name “ARCHIE THOMPSON” appears in small, light gray capital letters. There are no additional objects or features in the composition, and the background remains uniformly plain.
title: Pa. German Moravian Loving Cup
